'''Mei Lai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]], who in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top ten most wanted fugitives for unauthorized use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked her down and killed her.

She was possibly related to [[Ros Lai]].
